The '''energy lance''' was the primary weapon of the [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Mon Calamari Knights]] operating on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The weapon was essentially [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]] equipped with an electromagnetic pulse generator and balance for use in the mounted combat. At the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]], Mon Calamari Knights used these weapons to fry [[manta droid subfighter]]s.
